scope: Audited foundation scenarios, not the complete Android API surface. Passed means only the named regression scenario passed.

scenarios.name: Native JNI mixed arguments and returns
App storage and real filesystem capacity
Atomic CAS identity and integer overflow
Java exceptions and reflection
scenarios.evidence: Real proxy InvocationHandler dispatch, DEX member enumeration and field payload tests pass; builtin metadata and exception coverage remain incomplete

scenarios.name: Graphics and native library startup
scenarios.evidence: ZZZ loads five DEX files and ARM64 libmain/libil2cpp; independent gameplay is unverified

scenarios.name: Gamepad and input
scenarios.evidence: Xbox One/360 InputManager checks pass on ART; independent DexVM input routing is incomplete

scenarios.name: Android Resources and View layout
scenarios.evidence: Minimal builtin objects; no general replacement for Android layout/resource services

scenarios.name: Independent WebView and network framework
scenarios.evidence: No independent Chromium/WebView, Android HTTP/TLS framework replacement

scenarios.name: Garbage collection and monitor semantics
scenarios.evidence: Reentrant DEX/JNI monitors and wait/notify tests pass; heap objects are retained and GC/reference lifetime remain incomplete

scenarios.name: Choreographer frame scheduling
scenarios.evidence: choreographer_queues_once_on_its_looper_and_removes_callbacks passes; software clock only, no compositor vsync
